WHEREAS by order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (RevisedEdition 1956) as amended by Acts, No. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes(Special Provisions)Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 03.05.2019 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extra-Ordinary No.2122/45 dated 09.05.2019 the Industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour dated11.04.2019.
01. Mr. K.P.Pemasiri, Pinikahana, Kahadowa 02. Mr. B.A. Dharmasena Jayantha, No. 32/A9, Wickramage Mawatha,Brahmanagama, Pannipitiya" of the one part

Mr. Naveen de Silva (Infrastructure and Club, House Development Secretary), 6. Mr. SanjeewaWickramanayake (Ground Secretary), 7. Mr. Suren Madanayake (F and B Secretary), 8. Mr. Saneth Gamage (Treasurer) 9. Mr. WasanthaDe Silva (Marcom Secretary), Royal Colombo Golf Club, No. 223, Model Farm Road, Colombo 08. of the other part

Colombo,04th November, 2019.
